canonical_string_normalization: Unicode-preserving casefold, trim, collapse internal whitespace, normalize hyphen/slash spacing only where a field-specific alias says so.
unknown_output: A missing, unknown, conflicted, not_available, or not_applicable system output for a scorable known answer is U.
known_mismatch: A known system output that does not satisfy the frozen rule is E.
not_applicable_ground_truth: Excluded from N; never converted to Unknown or error.
unresolved_ground_truth: Applicable but excluded from N because exact defensible evidence was unavailable before provider execution.
provenance: A correct researched known fact requires at least one source; deterministic pounds_per_horsepower is provenance-exempt.

metrics.headline: Unweighted macro-average of vehicle-family CEFC; the two MINI fixture CEFC values are averaged into one MINI family CEFC.

brakes_wheels_and_tires.rotor_diameters_.comparison: each numeric component uses its frozen tolerance; all components must match for the canonical field to be C

brakes_wheels_and_tires.default_tire.comparison: brand/model is normalized exact; sizes ignore case and whitespace only; all components must match

energy_storage.capacity.comparison: each non-null numeric component uses its frozen tolerance; a null component must remain null; all components must match

suspension_axles_and_chassis.suspension_.comparison: normalized exact with only the frozen aliases below; both axles must match

powertrain_semantics.horsepower: ICE uses engine rated hp; HEV/PHEV uses manufacturer combined-system hp; EV uses manufacturer combined-system peak hp when published.
powertrain_semantics.torque: ICE uses engine rated lb-ft; HEV/PHEV uses manufacturer combined-system lb-ft; EV uses manufacturer combined-system peak lb-ft when published.
powertrain_semantics.battery_capacity: gross/total kWh only; usable capacity is documented but not substituted.
powertrain_semantics.pounds_per_horsepower: curb_weight_lb / horsepower, round-half-even as Python round to two decimal places; unavailable/nonpositive input makes the result unresolved.

adas_semantics.adaptive_cruise_control: Feature presence; ordinary fixed-speed cruise does not qualify.
adas_semantics.acc_full_stop_and_go: Requires ACC to brake to a complete stop, hold/maintain stopped traffic state, and resume/continue low-speed following. Braking to zero followed by prompt cancellation does not qualify.
adas_semantics.active_lane_centering: Continuous steering assistance that tracks lane center; warning, departure prevention, or momentary correction alone does not qualify.

lsd_semantic: True only for an exact-configuration mechanical limited-slip differential or an explicitly documented electronic differential function that actively apportions axle/wheel torque as an LSD. Brake-based traction control and selectable full lockers alone do not qualify.
instrumented_semantics: 0-60 seconds, average lateral acceleration in g, and 70-0 feet must come from an exact-configuration instrumented test. Manufacturer claims and tests of different trim, transmission, tire, package, drivetrain, body, or model year are not substituted.
